Hoopa

Psychic Ghost

Kalos · Generation 6 · Mythical Pokémon

Hoopa is a Psychic/Ghost-type Mischief Pokémon first found in Kalos (Generation 6), and is classed as a Mythical Pokémon. It stands 0.5 m tall and weighs 9 kg. It does not evolve. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (150), with a base stat total of 600.
